nodes.asset_description: Playful, hand-drawn-style border of cartoon readers and stacks of books arranged around the poster edges, connected by a looping pink cord/ribbon. Top-left: seated person in pink sweater and blue pants reading a yellow book; near them several open/closed books. Top-right: person in green patterned sweater and lilac pants reading; nearby an open book and a small stack. Mid-left and mid-right edges: small illustrated open books and book stacks attached to the looping cord. Bottom-left: seated person in an orange hoodie and teal socks reading; bottom-right: person with long hair in lilac sweater and brown pants reading. Along the bottom edge are a few colorful book stacks. The central area is left clear for typography.
